hero.title: PROJECT BATTAMBANG
hero.subtitle: ~ love above all else ~
hero.description: An overseas community service project organized by medical students from the Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine, National University of Singapore.

roots.title: Our Roots
roots.story: At the heart of Project Battambang is a belief in sustainable, locally grounded service. Beyond providing short-term support, we aim to listen closely, build lasting relationships, and strengthen existing community systems.

vision_mission.vision: We envision an independent community where everyone has the liberty and means to hope for and achieve a better future together.
vision_mission.mission: To serve the people of Battambang with heart and humility, while nurturing empathetic healthcare leaders for tomorrow.

values.name: Love Above All Else
values.description: Driven by genuine care, empathy, and compassion in every interaction with the community.

values.name: Integrity & Transparency
values.description: Upholding high ethical standards, stewardship of funds, and clear accountability.

values.name: Belief in Local Systems
values.description: Working alongside Cambodian doctors, local health centers, and community leaders to ensure long-term sustainability.

values.name: Respect & Humility
values.description: Listening to villagers' needs, honoring local culture, and learning from the community.

values.name: Advocacy for Health
values.description: Empowering communities through preventive health education, hygiene, and accessible primary care.

values.name: Sustainability
values.description: Building capacity, supporting education, and measuring long-term impact for self-reliance.

initiatives.title: Health Screening
initiatives.description: Comprehensive clinical triage, doctor consultations, chronic disease monitoring, and pharmacy dispensary.

initiatives.title: Education Outreach
initiatives.description: Hygiene workshops, preventive health modules, school outreach, and student scholarships.

initiatives.title: Post-Trip Reports
initiatives.description: Transparently documenting our annual trip findings, clinical statistics, financial statements, and community impact.
